jobs.prompt:
FILE ACCESS: your declared outputs are readable. Train 9, one release (1.167.36), four display-only fixes. Do not change ticket statuses, ledger writes, run behavior, or the canonical live-set definitions. Add tests for each behavior.

1) CANCELLED/PERCENT NOTE (owner order): the Cockpit footer currently says '13 cancelled, left out of the percent' while the displayed 57% is 230/407. The live ledger has 420 rows: 407 live tickets (cancelled already excluded) + 13 cancelled, so 230/407 = 57% is correct and 230/394 would double-exclude cancelled. Choose the owner's 'change the note' option: keep the percent at 57 and make the footer explicit, e.g. '13 cancelled, not counted in the 407 live tickets or the percent' (use the actual counts from project.counts; omit the clause when cancelled is 0). Update the Hive tooltip wording to match ('done divided by live tickets; cancelled not counted'). Do NOT change any denominator or percentDone value.

2) REAL DONE 24H: done tickets in the ledger have no doneAt/updatedAt fields, so throughput24h returns null and the Hive shows '—'. The real source is .swarm/project/tickets.log: lines like {"at":"...","event":"transition","id":"T-....","to":"done"}. tools/client-report.mjs already exports doneTimes(root) for this. In tools/board-data.mjs add a small helper that scans the project's family roots (same roots already passed to lastTicketFinishedAt) with doneTimes, merges by ticket id, and counts unique ids whose done time is within the last 24 hours (allow a small future-clock tolerance). Add `doneLast24h` to BOTH projectOverview() and projectDetail() returns next to lastTicketFinishedAt. If the log is readable but empty, return 0 (not null); if the roots cannot be read, 0. In tools/command-center-snapshot.mjs buildHiveExtras, when any top-level project carries a finite doneLast24h, set hive.doneLast24h to their sum (0 is valid) instead of leaving it undefined; keep the existing throughput24h chart behavior as a fallback. The Hive header and panel must show the real number (0 is fine; '—' only when the field is absent).

3) NUMERIC STAGE ORDER: stage ids are S1..S11; string sorting produces S1,S10,S11,S2. Add one numeric stage comparator (parse /^S(\d+)$/; non-matching ids sort after by localeCompare) and apply it everywhere stage lists/keys are sorted or displayed. At minimum fix tools/watch-assets/cockpit-view.js stageRingProgress (both the ledger.scope.stages list and the Object.keys(byStage) fallback); search the other watch assets and server sorters for the same stage-key sort and use the comparator. Add a test where stages S1,S2,S10 render in numeric order.

4) DIRECT-BUILD MODE + AUTO-HIDE (display only):
- A project entry may carry `directBuild: true` (the per-project switch; the live board will set it for parts-request-app in ~/.project-swarm/projects.json, which the board receives as project objects). In tools/board-data.mjs projectOverview() and projectDetail(), include `directBuild: Boolean(project.directBuild)` in the returned project. In tools/board-inbox.mjs, skip a project entirely when project.directBuild is true, so none of its needs-you items are returned or counted.
- In tools/command-center-snapshot.mjs buildProjectCard(), when p.directBuild is true omit ticketCounts, percentDone, meter, asks, fails and ticketsBuilding, and make projectLane return 'control'. The project card still appears, but its swarm counts are hidden and it contributes no totals. In buildProjectCockpit(), include directBuild: true and keep the ledger, but make the headline counts hidden in the UI.
- In tools/watch-assets/cc-hive-mount.js and cc-cockpit-mount.js, render a small muted 'direct build' state instead of swarm counts when project.directBuild is true (Hive card: no ticket rows/percent; Cockpit: header/tiles show 0 or '—' and the footer says 'direct build: swarm counts hidden'). Do not hide the project itself and do not show stale counts from the ledger.
- Auto-hide needs-you: in tools/board-inbox.mjs, after collecting each project's items, drop an item when (a) its ledger ticket status is superseded or cancelled (match the item id to a ticket id), or (b) kind is 'blocker' and its `since` is older than 7 days. Keep recent blockers and keep held/proposed items that are not superseded/cancelled. Count only the surviving items. Do not change what counts as needs-you, only remove these stale/superseded rows.

TESTS: extend tests/board-inbox.test.mjs (direct-build skip; an 8-day blocker hidden while a 2-day held ticket stays; a superseded ticket item hidden), tests/command-center-counts.test.mjs (direct-build project contributes no totals and no ticketCounts; a project with doneLast24h 3 makes hive.doneLast24h 3), tests/command-center-lists.test.mjs or cc-cockpit-mount.test.mjs (S1,S2,S10 numeric order), tests/cc-hive-mount.test.mjs (direct-build card hides counts; percent note/tooltip still reflects 57 and 407 live), tests/cc-cockpit-mount.test.mjs (footer says cancelled are not counted in the live total/percent; direct-build hides headline counts). Update existing expectations only where they encoded the old display behavior.

CONSTRAINTS: no new dependencies; keep the Command Center payload money-free; no hard-coded live numbers in production paths; do not edit .swarm/; do not change tools/ticket-counts.mjs' live-set/ready definitions; keep the 57% math.

Verify: node --import ./tests/_isolate-config.mjs --test tests/board-inbox.test.mjs tests/command-center-counts.test.mjs tests/command-center-snapshot.test.mjs tests/command-center-hive.test.mjs tests/command-center-hive-panels.test.mjs tests/command-center-lists.test.mjs tests/cc-hive-mount.test.mjs tests/cc-cockpit-mount.test.mjs tests/board-accuracy-percent.test.mjs -> all pass.
